summary.headline: Chapter V: On Substance
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging illness and death through Mars, reception, and the lightness of pain, followed by Chapter V on substance. The chapter explains how to determine whether someone will obtain substance using the ascendant, Moon, second domicile, their lords, aspects, conjunctions, reception, fortunes, and infortunes.
